metadata.question: Did the area around Windhoek, Nambia during February, 2021 show higher NDVI than the 2010 to 2020 average for the same month?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to compare NDVI for February 2021 vs. average NDVI for February across 2010-2020 in Windhoek, Namibia - Use Sentinel-2 (better spatial resolution, available from 2015) or Landsat 8 (available from 2013) - For 2010-2014, Landsat 7/5 may be needed; for 2015+, Sentinel-2 is preferred - Define Windhoek area as a point buffer or small polygon 2. Masking strategy: - Cloud mask both Sentinel-2 (QA60) and Landsat (BQA) to get valid vegetation pixels - This is a vegetation question, so masking clouds is essential 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null: - Check pixel counts after cloud masking for both periods - Valid NDVI should be in range [-1, 1]; check for NaN - A valid zero NDVI is possible (bare ground), but negative NDVI < -0.3 is unlikely for vegetation - If either period returns 0 valid pixels → C2 - If either period has no images → C1 - Compare Feb 2021 NDVI against Feb 2010-2020 mean; if Feb 2021 > mean → A, else → B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Windhoek, Namibia geometry const windhoek = ee.Geometry.Point([17.0832, -22.5597]); // Windhoek coordinates const bufferDist = 25000; // 25 km buffer for area analysis const aoiGeom = windhoek.buffer(bufferDist); // 2. Cloud masking functions function maskCloudsS2(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; return image.updateMask(qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0))); } function maskCloudsL8(image) { const qa = image.select('BQA'); return image.updateMask(qa.lt(2800)); // Mask clouds and shadows } function calcNDVI(image) { return image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); } function calcNDVIL8(image) { return image.normalizedDifference(['B5', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); } // 3. Fetch February 2021 data (Sentinel-2) const feb2021 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(aoiGeom) .filterDate('2021-02-01', '2021-02-28') .map(maskCloudsS2) .map(calcNDVI); const feb2021Size = feb2021.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Feb 2021 (S2) Images: ${feb2021Size}`); if (feb2021Size === 0) { // Fallback to Landsat 8 const feb2021L8 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(aoiGeom) .filterDate('2021-02-01', '2021-02-28') .map(maskCloudsL8) .map(calcNDVIL8); const feb2021L8Size = feb2021L8.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Feb 2021 (L8) Images: ${feb2021L8Size}`); if (feb2021L8Size === 0) { console.log('No images found for Feb 2021.'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // 4. Aggregate Feb 2021 NDVI (use mean composite) const feb2021Composite = feb2021.mean(); const feb2021ValidPixels = feb2021Composite.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: aoiGeom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`Feb 2021 Valid Pixels: ${feb2021ValidPixels}`); if (feb2021ValidPixels === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels for Feb 2021 after masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } const feb2021NDVI = feb2021Composite.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: aoiGeom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`Feb 2021 Mean NDVI: ${feb2021NDVI?.toFixed(4) || 'NULL'}`); // 5. Fetch Feb 2010-2020 historical data // Use Landsat for 2010-2012 (Landsat 5/7), Landsat 8 for 2013+ let febHistorical = ee.ImageCollection([]); // Landsat 5 & 7 for 2010-2012 const febL5L7 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(aoiGeom) .filterDate('2010-02-01', '2013-02-28') .map(maskCloudsL8) .map(calcNDVIL8); // Landsat 8 for 2013-2020 const febL8Hist = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(aoiGeom) .filterDate('2013-02-01', '2020-02-28') .map(maskCloudsL8) .map(calcNDVIL8); // Sentinel-2 for 2015-2020 const febS2Hist = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(aoiGeom) .filterDate('2015-02-01', '2020-02-28') .map(maskCloudsS2) .map(calcNDVI); febHistorical = febL5L7.merge(febL8Hist).merge(febS2Hist); const febHistSize = febHistorical.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Feb 2010-2020 Historical Images: ${febHistSize}`); if (febHistSize === 0) { console.log('No historical Feb data found for 2010-2020.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 6. Calculate Feb 2010-2020 mean NDVI const febHistComposite = febHistorical.mean(); const febHistValidPixels = febHistComposite.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: aoiGeom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`Feb 2010-2020 Valid Pixels: ${febHistValidPixels}`); if (febHistValidPixels === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels for historical Feb data.'); console.log('C2'); return; } const febHistNDVI = febHistComposite.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: aoiGeom, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`Feb 2010-2020 Mean NDVI: ${febHistNDVI?.toFixed(4) || 'NULL'}`); // 7. Validation & Final Answer if (feb2021NDVI === null || febHistNDVI === null || isNaN(feb2021NDVI) || isNaN(febHistNDVI) || feb2021NDVI < -1 || feb2021NDVI > 1 || febHistNDVI < -1 || febHistNDVI > 1) { console.log('Invalid NDVI calculation result.'); console.log('C3'); return; } console.log(`Feb 2021 NDVI: ${feb2021NDVI.toFixed(4)}, Feb 2010-2020 Avg: ${febHistNDVI.toFixed(4)}`); if (feb2021NDVI > febHistNDVI) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
